name: @tile/cardtile
description: REEF with Card — the Card content model (markdown in, a rendered page out) and its edge worker. Not published to npm; this manifest exists so serve/gen-assets.mjs can RESOLVE @cvernet/signet instead of reaching into a sibling package's node_modules.
//: 🩸 WHY THIS FILE EXISTS (2026-08-12). gen-assets.mjs read signet from
CVERInc/tile repo, that path stopped existing here, and the generator has been dead since —
silently, because nothing runs it on a schedule. The drift gate ('the bundled stylesheet is
the one on disk') is what surfaced it, on the first edit to card.css after the graduation.
🔴 A vendored COPY of signet was the wrong fix and is a standing red line: signet is an import
package, and the only copy lives in npm. To reach live it goes publish -> bump -> deploy, and a
local copy is how that chain gets quietly bypassed. So: a declared dependency, at `latest`,
matching how tile's own packages/sitetile/astro/package.json declares it.
